formulas.total_cogs: equipment_cogs + services_cogs + provision_loss_contracts_cogs + ppa_cogs + fuel_cogs + other_cogs

revenue_yoy.description: Total revenue YoY growth rate vs Q-4

cogs_margin_delta_bps.description: Total COGS as % of total revenue, delta vs Q-4

rd_yoy.description: R&D expense YoY growth rate vs Q-4

sga_yoy.description: SG&A expense YoY growth rate vs Q-4

other_expense_margin_delta_bps.description: Other expense net as % of total revenue, delta vs Q-4

provision_loss_contracts_yoy.description: Provision for loss contracts YoY growth rate vs Q-4

restructuring_abs.description: restructuring absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

impairment_abs.description: impairment absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

change_contingent_consideration_abs.description: change_contingent_consideration absolute dollar value for the target quarter (predict the amount directly; 0 if none expected)

nci_loss_abs.description: nci_loss absolute dollar value for the target quarter (below-pretax line; predict directly, 0 if none expected).

shares_abs.description: shares: diluted weighted-average share count for the target quarter (predict the count directly; drifts slowly with buybacks/issuance).

tax_rate.description: Effective GAAP tax rate for the target quarter (decimal, e.g. 0.14 = 14%; may be negative in a benefit quarter). Choose from the GAAP historical anchors provided; a discrete tax item can push it far from any of them.
